primary.entity: small navy-blue cloth held in the creature's paw
primary.what: In f0 the creature's right paw (screen right) clutches a small navy-blue cloth or ribbon; from f1 on the paw is empty and no dropped cloth of that color is visible on the ground.

secondary.entity: rooftop floor / roof surface (part of the place)
secondary.what: The 'same rooftop' surface changes from shot to shot: gray weathered decking (Shot2), blue curved roof tiles (Shot3), light wooden decking (Shot4), flat dark roof (Shot5), orange clay tiles overhead (Shot8).

secondary.entity: rooftop lighting / time of day (part of the place)
secondary.what: Shot2 is lit like overcast daytime (flat gray daylight, unlit building windows) while every other shot is set at night.
Short-sleeved red T-shirt in Shot2 and Shot7, but a long-sleeved red top in Shot4.
Royal-blue leggings in Shot2, pale lavender tights under denim shorts in Shot4, bare legs with blue-white striped knee socks in Shot7.
A thin red cord necklace is visible at her neckline in Shot4 but her neck is bare in the Shot6 close view.
The creature's head changes design between shots: shaggy brow without horns (Shot1), two small horns (Shot3), gray mohawk tuft (Shot5), pointed side ears on a monkey-like face (Shot8).
Between f4 and f5 the gray face mask shrinks to two gray eye patches and a muzzle; the blue eyes and teeth are no longer visible.
A white fluffy tail-like limb appears beside the creature's right side only in f2.

unspecified_seen: Few unprompted things, each in one shot only: wooden crate under the platform (Shot2), small box on the tiled roof (Shot3, may be one of the prompt's two blocks), cables, a white pipe and a stick along the parapet/deck (Shot4), piles of clothes on the ground and a small blue cloth in the creature's paw (Shot5), green bin and a dark sloped roof structure (Shot7), wire hanger on the rail (Shot8); none recurs across shots. The large maroon cloth in Shot5 that morphs (draped cloth f0, hanging curtain f1, swinging garment f2) and vanishes at f3 is counted as the prompt's Shot5 hanging sheet, not as unspecified.
